title: Quick Dutch Pancake Bake
description: A simple and flavorful Dutch pancake bake, featuring jalapeno and poached eggs. Perfect for a quick and delicious brunch.

ingredients.name: 1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour
ingredients.notes: Use a fine-milled flour for best results.

ingredients.name: 2 teaspoons baking powder
ingredients.notes: Make sure baking powder is fresh for best results.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup milk
ingredients.notes: Use whole milk for best flavor.

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup diced jalapeno
ingredients.notes: Adjust the level of heat to your liking.

instructions: Grease a 9-inch round baking dish with butter or cooking spray.
In a large bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
In a separate bowl, whisk together milk, egg, and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish.
Top with diced jalapeno and a sprinkle of salt.
Bake for 25-30 minutes or until the pancake is golden brown and set.
While the pancake is baking, poach 2 eggs and set aside.
Once the pancake is done, remove it from the oven and let it cool for 2-3 minutes.
Place a poached egg on top of the pancake and serve immediately.
